releaseNotes:
1. Silent Direct 80mm Printing: Configured Chromium kiosk printing and automated Windows default printer synchronization for instant silent receipts without popup preview dialogs.
2. Perfect Continuous Thermal Layout: 0mm top margin eliminating blank paper waste, unclipped full invoice print (Store header, itemized table, taxes, grand total, payment tenders, footer & feed spacing).
3. Clean Font & Aligned Receipt Columns: Fixed-table column layout preventing Rate/Amount collision, crisp typography matching Admin Hub live preview.
